subject: Fitting measurement error model with known errors

messages.author: 1457d345496c6c07
messages.subject: Fitting measurement error model with known errors
parts:
I am trying to use INLA to estimate a Berkson measurement error model, where I have a poisson count as the outcome. For example, I have attached the data called exdat. I have a single predictor, which is estimated with error, and I have the errors in the data as well, on the standard error scale for each estimate. 

I am trying to do fit the model using f(pblack, model="meb")
but I do not know where to include the measured errors in the model, which seems necessary. It seems like I should be able to put the errors directly in f() but I don't know where.

#rexpress standard error of estimate as precision
exdat$blprec<-1/(exdat$pblackerr^2)

form<-deaths~f(pblack, model = "meb", observed precisions???)

fit<-inla(form,  family="poisson",E=popest, data=exdat)
summary(fit)

Any advice would be greatly appreciated.
-Corey Sparks
